campusInfo.name: MIT World Peace University
campusInfo.motto: Transforming the World with Peace & Innovation

spots.name: Swami Vivekananda Library
spots.description: State-of-the-art multi-tier library with digital repository, high-speed workstations, and dedicated silent research zones.
spots.seniorTip: Floor 4 has soundproof pods ideal for team prep before symposiums.

spots.name: Quantum AI & Robotics Foundry
spots.description: Hardware testing benches, NVIDIA GPU clusters, and drone testing cages for student researchers.
spots.seniorTip: Lab assistants conduct weekly hands-on ROS and PyTorch workshops on Saturday mornings.

spots.name: Open Sky Amphitheater
spots.description: Tiered open-air auditorium for musical jams, street plays, and relaxing between lectures.
spots.seniorTip: Sunset hours between 5:30 PM and 7:00 PM are the best for relaxing with friends.
